about: Stage A layout of the DDFC 2nd floor. Positions come from a hand sketch mapped onto the traced official floor plan; they are approximate until verified (Stage C).
coordinates: x, y = item center in feet from the top-left of the base map. rotation = degrees clockwise (wall alignment only; facing direction not known yet). width runs along the item's own x-axis, depth along its y-axis.
scale: ESTIMATE: 28 ft per column bay. Will be corrected once one wall is taped/paced.
